title: Pretty Basic
text: Pretty Basic. The Amazon Basic line is just that, pretty basic. I like the product line, but they're nothing fancy. Some of the items are surprises and better than expected, but some such as this one are just average or okay. This bench is a pressed wood kit that you have to assemble. Instructions were easy enough to follow. I ordered this to be used at the top of the basement stairs for our 21 year old son, who lives in the basement,  to use for his shoes and belongings. It's sturdy enough, but I've told him not to sit on it because he's a big guy. It is an improvement of having him leave his stuff on the floor at the top of the basement. The cushion is thin, but adequate. It attaches to the bench with vel-cro so it doesn't slide around. Overall, it's okay. It does the job.
